name: hyperframes-animation
works_with: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, IBM Bob, OpenCode and other agents that support skills. HyperFrames needs Node.js 22+ and FFmpeg
short: Teaches your coding agent motion rules, scene templates and transitions for HyperFrames videos made from HTML.
what: The animation skill for HyperFrames, an open-source framework that renders HTML, CSS and seekable animations into MP4 video. It gives your agent atomic motion rules, multi-phase scene blueprints, scene transitions and notes for seven animation runtimes (GSAP by default, plus Lottie, Three.js, Anime.js, CSS keyframes, Web Animations API and TypeGPU). It also includes a script that maps a composition's animations to spot dead zones and timing problems.
who: Developers and designers making product videos, motion graphics or social clips with an AI coding agent. Skip it if you don't use HyperFrames; it is one of the domain skills the /hyperframes router loads on demand.
needs: A coding agent that supports skills

steps.title: In Claude Code, install the plugin
steps.text: Then use /hyperframes:hyperframes. The plugin bundles the full skill set.
steps.code:
claude plugin marketplace add heygen-com/hyperframes
claude plugin install hyperframes@hyperframes

steps.title: Or install the core skills for any agent
steps.text: The core set includes the router and the hyperframes-* domain skills, this one included. It installs from the current main branch.

steps.title: Or pick skills interactively
steps.text: Choose the Core Skills group in the picker.

steps.title: Start a project and preview it
steps.code:
npx hyperframes init my-video
cd my-video
npx hyperframes preview      # preview in browser with live reload
npx hyperframes render       # render to MP4

try.label: From the README
try.text: Using /hyperframes, create a 10-second product intro with a fade-in title, a background video, and subtle background music.

watch: The /hyperframes router runs npx hyperframes skills update to install creation workflows on demand, so your agent will fetch and install more skills as it goes.
npx skills add pulls from the skills.sh registry, which the README says can lag main by hours.
The animation-map script can bootstrap the bundled HyperFrames package from npm if it is not in your project.
Cloning the full repo for development pulls about 240 MB of test videos through Git LFS. You don't need that to use the skill.
